title: CHU de Bordeaux cyberattack, Nov 2026

subject.name: CHU de Bordeaux
subject.about: The CHU de Bordeaux is the university hospital of Bordeaux, in south-west France. It has about 16,000 staff, and in 2025 it recorded more than 311,800 hospital stays and nearly 836,000 outpatient consultations and procedures.

also_called: the CHU de Bordeaux data breach
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by the CHU de Bordeaux, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: The CHU de Bordeaux is one of France's large university hospitals, with about 16,000 staff and over 311,000 hospital stays a year. It has not said how many people's data may be involved, so the size rests on the hospital's reach, not a count.
who_is_affected: Patients and staff of the Bordeaux University Hospital whose data may have been reached; the hospital has not said who or how many. Care continues as normal. Anyone affected will be contacted individually. Treat unexpected emails that seem to come from the hospital with care.

known.text: The hospital says its investigations confirmed a compromise of its information system.
It found out after two of its email addresses were used to send mass emails to staff.
It says patient care is not affected; it cut outside access to one server as a precaution.
ANSSI was informed, the CNIL notified, and a criminal complaint will be filed.

not_known.text: Whether patient data was taken, and how many people are affected.
Who is behind it and how they got in. A group calls itself responsible; the hospital has not confirmed that.

figures.label: Hospital confirms a compromise
figures.detail: A day after saying it had found no sign of one

figures.label: Hospital email addresses misused
figures.detail: To send mass emails to staff
